gen-megrim-gf-orienta: Orienta breathes wide through its counters, and its lowercase sits almost level with the capitals. Megrim stays angular and futuristic above, every stroke one measured thickness, while the plain sans below would carry running text without fuss.
gen-megrim-gf-oxygen: Futuristic and angular, Megrim sets every stroke to one measured thickness. Oxygen follows with curves that never close back on themselves, and a long run of its sans text would read smoothly, lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-megrim-gf-questrial: Angular and futuristic, Megrim draws each stroke at a measured thickness, with a c open like a bent paperclip. And Questrial, the plain sans here, offers a flat, stencil-cut counterpart with strokes of single weight and generous openings.
gen-megrim-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada keeps its sans lowercase full and upright, with a steady line and open curve endings. Megrim excels at angular, futuristic flair; Radio Canada at plain, unfussy clarity.
gen-megrim-gf-savate: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with every stroke measured. Savate, the plain sans here, adds a moderate thickness shift you feel more than see, giving Megrim's uniform lines a softer companion.
gen-megrim-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk reads friendly and open, its e and a generous. Its standout quality is how softly it sits against Megrim, whose angular, futuristic strokes all carry the same visual weight.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-tiktok-sans: Pipe-cleaner lines and outsized lowercase: Tektur is pure expressive personality, with zero stroke contrast. TikTok Sans is the one for steady reading, its x-height rising close to cap height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-vend-sans: Commanding, Tilt Neon runs a tube-like, constant-width stroke with a splayed c. Vend Sans, the plain sans, draws a ruler-straight line with unclosed curve endings, and running text would move along smoothly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sen: Distinctive and bold, Gugi cuts its terminals open so the counters flow outward. Sen is the quieter worker, a sans-serif with a constant-weight line, where Gugi is the one that grabs attention.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sofia-sa: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps a level beat, tips pointing outward. Sofia Sans, the plain sans, adds rounded letters with one open side and no stroke contrast, so the page gets expressive energy above and clean order below.
